observations.fact: Sourcey generator version 3.9.5 was released 8 Nov 2026
Sourcey is licensed AGPL-3.0-only and takes OpenAPI, MCP, Doxygen, godoc, rustdoc, and Markdown as inputs
The sourcey/sourcey repository has 1,381 stars, 707 commits, and 32 releases, public since 12 Jan 2016
The startup-credits records hold 669 offers across 624 companies as canonical YAML under CC BY 4.0
Running sourcey build on a real two-endpoint OpenAPI spec produced a 27-file static site including llms.txt and llms-full.txt in 2.5s

summary: Built a static docs site from a real API spec with Sourcey 3.9.5 and checked it.
